scope: One fixed 64-source exact-software near-view window; source-paired native queue intervals only

diagnosticScopeMap.begin2/end2: Reconstruction (CSTemporal or CSTemporalIdentity through all CSFilter iterations)

derivedIntervalMeaning.FormalSum: Sum of ReceiverCapture, Transport and Composite on each source before statistics
derivedIntervalMeaning.OtherTransport: Formal Transport minus WorldCache and Gather on each source; includes Reconstruction
derivedIntervalMeaning.TransportRemainder: Formal Transport minus all three child intervals on each source; other commands, gaps and instrumentation

statisticsMeaning: Descriptive 64-source statistics; p95/p99 use linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; four consecutive 16-source blocks. No acceptance or speedup threshold.
limitations: Queue intervals can include barriers, waits and timing instrumentation; not pure shader ALU cost.
No CPU preparation, whole-application GPU time, actual Present, image quality or memory budget decision.
Startup failures/cancellations remain in the collection; only the selected window and its drain must retain stable counters.
Post-Stop pending cancellation is accounting, not proof that every native GPU query storage allocation was synchronously destroyed.
Build/source/restoration and log verification are outside this reader; native-exit.json is reported as supplied, without hashing.

collection.scope: Release214 ordinary default near view of NeutralThreeRooms, expansion disabled; 960x540 backbuffer, half-resolution GI, 2 rays and 4 filters; exact software; NativeDX12 three-range intervals and same-window process memory.
collection.cadenceMeaning: CPU time between consecutive target-camera endCameraRendering callbacks; not CPU busy time, actual Present timing or full-frame GPU duration.
collection.scopeExclusions: CPU preparation, uploads outside scopes, query resolve, whole-app GPU time, actual Present timing, instantaneous VRAM peak and GI-exclusive allocation. Queue intervals can include barriers/waits. Ledger estimates are not additive or a total-VRAM measurement.
